reason: My notes, lists and budget already live in Apple Notes and Google Docs, they're free and they sync fine between my phone and laptop. I might poke at the free tier out of curiosity, but I can't see myself paying $6 a month to move everything into a new app.
objection: Moving years of notes and docs into something new is a pain, and if this startup shuts down or changes its pricing I'm stuck with my stuff locked in someone else's app. My mess works well enough.
would_change_my_mind: If it could pull in my existing Notes and Google Docs in one tap and export everything back out just as easily, and the snap-a-whiteboard thing actually saved me real time every week.
